jobDescription: The transaction monitoring product at a payments company screens transactions and presents alerts to compliance analysts. The Digital Product Manager owns the alert-review workflow's roadmap, prioritises the backlog with compliance operations, runs release reviews, and is expected to raise the share of alerts closed within the service-level target, reported against the product's documented monthly baseline.
requirements: Owns the alert-review workflow roadmap and prioritises the backlog with compliance operations.
Runs release reviews with engineering and compliance operations and records decisions.
Raises the share of alerts closed within the service-level target, reported against the documented monthly baseline.
Coordinates releases with engineering and compliance operations and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions for each release.

evidence.text: Owned the alert-review workflow roadmap for the transaction monitoring product, prioritising the backlog each sprint with the compliance operations lead and publishing the roadmap to the compliance director.
Ran the release review for each of the six workflow releases with engineering and compliance operations, recording decisions and open items in the release record.

The share of alerts closed within the service-level target rose from 71 percent to 88 percent over the four months after the alert-grouping release, per the compliance operations monthly report against its documented baseline of 71 percent.

Coordinated releases with the engineering manager and the compliance operations lead; the engineering manager set release dates and the compliance operations lead approved the rollout to analyst teams.
Wrote the release notes for each workflow release, including the known limitation that grouped alerts could not be split back into individual alerts, and the hand-over notes for analyst trainers.

Work sample: the compliance operations monthly report extract (alerts closed within target per month, baseline line, alert-grouping release marker) and the release record for the alert-grouping release, with the report identifiers as a verification trail.

Reference call with former compliance operations lead: confirmed the closure figures come from the monthly compliance operations report, that the alert-grouping release was the candidate's roadmap item, and the employment dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate has a three-month notice period; available for a product case study session next week.
